description: This file contains unit tests for error pattern matching functions related to provider-specific error handling and context overflow detection, using Vitest framework.

methods.name: describe
methods.description: Defines a test suite for a specific functionality or feature.

methods.name: expect
methods.description: Creates an expectation/assertion for a test case.

methods.name: it
methods.description: Defines an individual test case, optionally with parameterized data.

methods.name: vi.mock
methods.description: Mocks external modules or dependencies for testing purposes.

methods.name: classifyFailoverReason
methods.description: Classifies the reason for failover based on error messages.

methods.name: isContextOverflowError
methods.description: Detects whether an error message indicates a context overflow.

methods.name: classifyProviderSpecificError
methods.description: Classifies provider-specific error messages into categories like rate_limit, overloaded, etc.

methods.name: matchesProviderContextOverflow
methods.description: Checks if an error message matches known patterns of provider context overflow.
